revision.title: Explore apprenticeship training options
revision.summary: Compare apprenticeship categories and current entry rules; eligibility varies by category and opportunity.
revision.description: DGT describes apprenticeship training as workplace learning that supplements institutional training. For trade apprentices, its overview gives qualifications from Class VIII through Class XII and requires an apprenticeship contract. Check the category and terms of a specific opportunity with the responsible employer or authority.

steps: Compare the apprenticeship category and its current eligibility rules
Check the training arrangement and contract details
Confirm the terms of a specific opportunity with the responsible employer or authority

progression.title: Identify the relevant apprenticeship category
progression.description: DGT describes several apprentice categories. Requirements vary; use the current rules for the category and opportunity you are considering.

progression.title: Review the training and contract
progression.description: DGT describes trade apprenticeship training as basic training and practical training with related instruction, and says an apprenticeship contract is required.

progression.title: Confirm the specific opportunity
progression.description: Check the current conditions with the responsible employer or authority. The overview does not establish that a particular place is available or that an applicant will be selected.

qualification.title: Apprenticeship training arrangement
qualification.description: DGT describes five apprenticeship categories. For trade apprentices, it describes basic and practical training with related instruction, and says those who pass the All India Trade Test receive a National Apprenticeship Certificate.

considerations.title: Eligibility depends on category and opportunity
considerations.description: DGT states that trade-apprentice qualifications range from Class VIII through Class XII. Check the current rules for the specific category and opening.

considerations.title: A contract is part of the arrangement
considerations.description: DGT describes the apprenticeship contract as required. Read the contract terms before accepting an opportunity.

considerations.title: Employer training arrangements vary
considerations.description: DGT says employers decide which apprentice categories and trades to engage based on facilities available for workplace training. Confirm the specific arrangement with the employer or responsible authority.

sources.authority: Directorate General of Training, Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India
sources.termsNotes: Official DGT overview. It does not establish that a specific apprenticeship is open, that a learner is eligible for it, or that placement, employment or a stipend is guaranteed.
sources.expectedUpdateBehavior: Recheck current category-specific rules and opportunity terms during review.
